t: The Site SWG360 cut resistant gloves offer high-performance hand protection for demanding trade tasks. These durable work gloves feature a Cut Level E rating, making them essential safety gloves for environments where sharp objects are present. Ideal for construction sites, workshops, or general trade use, the gloves incorporate elasticated knitted cuffs to effectively prevent debris ingress, ensuring a secure fit. A breathable back enhances comfort during extended wear, while the robust nitrile coating provides excellent grip and durability. Constructed with an HPPE liner, these grey marl and black gloves are designed for reliable, long-lasting protection.
